name: Visual Studio Code
layout_summary: Far-left Activity Bar: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run/Debug, Extensions icons. Left Sidebar: File Explorer tree or Search panel. Center: tabbed code editor panes. Bottom panel: Terminal, Output, Problems, Debug Console.
avoid_traps: Do NOT manually click through nested folders in the Explorer tree to open a known file — press ctrl+p, type the filename, and press enter.
Do NOT hunt through top menus for commands — press ctrl+shift+p to open the Command Palette.

command_palette.verify: Command Palette dropdown opens at top center with '>' prompt

quick_open_file.verify: Quick Open file picker opens and loads the target file

toggle_terminal.verify: Integrated terminal panel at bottom opens or focuses

toggle_sidebar.visual_fallback: smart_click('Explorer files icon at top-left Activity Bar')

find_in_file.verify: Find widget appears at top-right of active editor

find_in_project.visual_fallback: smart_click('Search magnifying glass icon on left Activity Bar')
find_in_project.verify: Workspace-wide Search sidebar opens and focuses search input

save_file.verify: Unsaved dot indicator on active editor tab disappears

close_editor.visual_fallback: smart_click('x close icon on active editor tab')
